cases.scenario: Locked product-hero plan with no runtime: blendops-build writes ordered build steps and routes to blendops-connect-blender
cases.inputPrompt: Apply blendops-build to a locked product-hero plan (sneaker, three-point light, 85 mm camera, PNG still). No Blender runtime is connected yet.
expectedBehavior: Produces pre_build_scene_check, pre_mutation_backup_record, per_step_json_reports for role scene-build-execution
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blendops-connect-blender (Runtime is not ready for building)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs ordered build steps conforming to skills/blendops-build/SKILL.md
Matches contract fallback predicate to blendops-connect-blender in skills/blendops-build/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Run readiness checks in blendops-connect-blender before executing the build steps.
simulatedOutput.summary: Wrote 10 ordered build steps (scene check, backup, units, block-out, modifiers, materials, lights, camera, preview, render), each with a JSON report, and routed to blendops-connect-blender because no runtime is ready.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Build steps produced a preview file; blendops-build hands off to blendops-final-check
cases.inputPrompt: While applying blendops-build, the workflow context is {"runtime.status":"Produced"} (Built output exists; check it against the done criteria). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the progression handoff predicate in skills/blendops-build/contract.json
Routes to blendops-final-check without claiming Verified
evidenceRequirements: Contract progression handoff predicate match to blendops-final-check

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off to blendops-final-check to check the built output against the done criteria.
simulatedOutput.summary: Matched progression predicate runtime.status=Produced and routed to blendops-final-check.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: A build step raised an error; blendops-build routes to blendops-fix-problems
cases.inputPrompt: While applying blendops-build, the workflow context is {"runtime.errorDetected":true} (A build step failed or the output looks wrong). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the conditional handoff predicate in skills/blendops-build/contract.json
Routes to blendops-fix-problems and does not claim the step succeeded
evidenceRequirements: Contract conditional handoff predicate match to blendops-fix-problems

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off to blendops-fix-problems with the failing step and its error text.
simulatedOutput.summary: Matched conditional predicate runtime.errorDetected=true and routed to blendops-fix-problems.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Blender 5.x build must use BLENDER_EEVEE and 4.0+ Principled socket names
cases.inputPrompt: Apply blendops-build: set EEVEE and add a neon glow material. The Blender version is not known yet.
expectedBehavior: Reads bpy.app.version before writing engine or socket names
Uses BLENDER_EEVEE on 5.0+, BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT on 4.2-4.5, and Emission Color on 4.0+

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Read bpy.app.version, then pick the engine id and socket names from the version table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Deferred engine and socket choice until bpy.app.version is read: BLENDER_EEVEE on 5.0+, BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT on 4.2-4.5; Emission Color and Emission Strength on 4.0+.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: GLB size budget question is delegated to blendops-glb-budget
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of building the scene, handle this request inside blendops-build: decide the GLB triangle and texture budget for mobile web.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the blendops-build exclusion boundary for GLB budget questions
Delegates to blendops-glb-budget without claiming runtime execution

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for blendops-build (GLB budget); delegate to blendops-glb-budget.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced blendops-build exclusion boundary and delegated the GLB budget decision to blendops-glb-budget.
warnings: blendops-build builds scenes and does not set GLB budgets.
